description: This file contains unit tests for the ModelCatalogLoader component, specifically testing the parsing of model data defined in TypeScript source code within test functions.

classes.name: ModelCatalogLoaderTests
classes.description: A test suite containing functions that verify the proper loading and parsing of model catalog data from source files.

methods.name: load parses models from type script and sorts
methods.description: Tests that the loader correctly parses model data from a TypeScript source string and sorts the models appropriately.

methods.name: load with no export returns empty choices
methods.description: Tests that when the source file contains no exported models, the loader returns an empty list of choices.
